subject.title: Bug: License incorrectly displayed as MIT-0 instead of MIT

question: Should ClawHub continue enforcing a fixed MIT-0 platform license for all published skills, or should it support declared MIT licenses for skills whose package metadata and LICENSE file say MIT?
rationale: Current main intentionally models fixed MIT-0, but this issue and the open linked PR present a concrete author-license mismatch that cannot be resolved safely as a display-only bug fix.

options.title: Approve mixed MIT/MIT-0 support
options.body: Treat the linked PR as the policy vehicle, require real behavior proof and a production backfill/runbook, then land the mixed-license contract if maintainers accept it.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0
options.body: Close the linked PR and update the issue/docs/operator copy so publish consent clearly explains that ClawHub terms override upstream package metadata for published skills.

options.title: Narrow to future publishes
options.body: Support declared MIT only for new publish/import flows and track existing stored versions as a separate migration decision.

recommendation.title: Approve mixed MIT/MIT-0 support
recommendation.body: Treat the linked PR as the policy vehicle, require real behavior proof and a production backfill/runbook, then land the mixed-license contract if maintainers accept it.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the MIT-0 enforcement commit and gave the prior product-direction comment closing the broader per-skill license PR.
